description: This file implements the SharedFdKeymasterChannel class, which manages communication over shared file descriptors for keymaster messages, including sending and receiving serialized messages with logging and error handling.

classes.name: SharedFdKeymasterChannel
classes.description: A class that facilitates communication with the keymaster service over shared file descriptors, providing methods to send requests, responses, and handle message serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: SharedFdKeymasterChannel
methods.description: Constructor initializing input and output shared file descriptors.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message with a specific command and serializable message payload.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message with a specific command and serializable message payload.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Core method to serialize and send a message, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives and deserializes a message from the input shared file descriptor, with logging and error handling.
